"Ravens X2" is down to one top prize after a $20,000 winner was claimed earlier this week. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Everything here about "Ravens X2" comes from official Maryland lottery numbers, current through November 24.
807.headline: Another top prize was claimed

808.body:
"Ravens X10" has three of four top prizes left and is in the middle of its run. About half of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Tomorrow's count on "Ravens X10" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
808.headline: Where this game is in its run

809.body:

Today's free summary of "Gold Bar Bingo" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.

810.headline: Early stage or late

811.body:
The prize money on "Extreme Green" leans toward many smaller prizes. It is spread over eleven prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $1 million. Games built like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

Every line of Extreme Green's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
811.headline: What type of game it is

812.body:
One of Loose Change®'s top prizes was claimed in this morning's update. A player in Maryland won $1,000. The game started with 24 top prizes and now has fourteen top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

If "Loose Change®" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
812.headline: Top prize count went down

813.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "The Price is Right™", about half are still unsold. The game is about halfway through its run, with four of six top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If "The Price is Right™" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.

Every line of High Voltage's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
814.headline: What the prize table shows

815.body:
"$100,000 Crossword" has gone three weeks without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a third of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $100,000 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

If you play "$100,000 Crossword" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
815.headline: Tickets sell, top prizes remain

816.body:
"Deluxe Crossword" is early in its run, with about three-quarters of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Everything here about "Deluxe Crossword" comes from official Maryland lottery numbers, current through November 24.
